_status: RESEARCH OUTPUT. No file in scripts/ was created or edited.
the_pattern: Every opening in this dataset is a 'why does...' or 'how does...' question and every dead end is a 'what is a...'. An identification question has one answer, so the first decent video closes it permanently; a mechanism question can always be answered better. These three subjects are kept and their questions reshaped.
method: Replacements are MINED from Google autocomplete using one identical mechanism-shaped template set per subject, then put through the same demand gate as every other candidate. Nothing here is invented.

competition_named_stop.name: YOUTUBE_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
competition_named_stop.what_is_missing: The saturation half of the gate for these candidates. search.list costs 100 units and the 10,000/day allowance was spent scoring the 20 existing episodes (2,040) and 74 domain queries (7,548).
competition_named_stop.consequence: Every candidate below carries competition: null. A recommendation to rework rests on demand evidence ALONE and is not final until the replacement question is shown to be unsaturated.
competition_named_stop.how_it_clears: Quota resets at midnight Pacific. Re-run `python weekly.py` and the candidates are scored automatically; no code change is needed.
